name: pills
title: Pills
description: Shaped, colored labels written in inline code: `{LIVE}` draws a capsule, `{BETA, tag, c4}` a sharp tag in the fourth categorical color, `{3, circle}` a numbered badge. A label comes first, then shape, color and size words in any order (or by name: `shape=tag`), and a pill sizes itself from the text around it. Pills are part of how Lattice draws a slide, so this plugin is embedded: it loads on every render and has no off switch. Components that show a status, an audience or a count author a pill or translate their content into one and pass in only a color, a size or a case.
